mind_map.root_node: Data Through Pictures (Data Handling, Tally Marks, Pictographs & Bar Graphs)

main_branches.branch_title: 1. Data Collection & Tally Mark Frequency Tables

key_nodes: Primary Data Definition: Firsthand information gathered directly through observation, counting, or measurement
Tally Mark Notation: Representing individual counts with vertical strokes (| = 1, || = 2, ||| = 3, |||| = 4)
5-Line Bundle (卌): Drawing 5th stroke diagonally across 4 vertical lines to complete a 5-unit bundle
Frequency Table: Summarizing tally counts into category rows with numerical totals
sub_branches.misconception_alert: Drawing 5 vertical lines before adding slash (a bundle 卌 contains 4 vertical + 1 diagonal = 5 total).
sub_branches.formula_or_rule: Tally Bundle Rule: Every 5th count is drawn as a diagonal slash across previous 4 vertical strokes.
sub_branches.real_world_application: Counting traffic vehicles, voting tally counts, and classroom attendance.

key_nodes: Categorical Grouping: Classifying raw data points into mutually exclusive categories
Sorting & Ordering Data: Arranging category frequencies from highest to lowest
Total Frequency Sum: Summing all individual category counts to verify grand total sample size
sub_branches.misconception_alert: Double counting data points or omitting categories during tally sorting.
sub_branches.formula_or_rule: Total Frequency = Sum of all individual category frequencies.
sub_branches.real_world_application: Survey data tabulations, retail store inventory counts, and sports statistics.

key_nodes: Pictograph Definition: Chart using icons or pictures to represent quantitative data
Scaled Key: Assigning a fixed numerical value to 1 picture symbol (e.g., 1 Tree Icon = 10 Real Trees)
Symbol Selection: Choosing intuitive visual icons matching data context
sub_branches.misconception_alert: Counting total icons without multiplying by key value (e.g., reporting 4 icons instead of 4 x 10 = 40 trees).
sub_branches.formula_or_rule: Pictograph Total = Number of Symbols x Value per Symbol.
sub_branches.real_world_application: Visual infographics in newspapers, agricultural crop reports, and weather charts.

key_nodes: Partial Symbol Representation: Drawing half or quarter icons to represent fractional key values (e.g., Half Icon = 5 Trees)
Key Selection Strategy: Choosing key value that divides all category counts cleanly (e.g., Key = 5 or 10)
Pictograph Limitations: Difficulty in depicting non-standard odd numbers accurately
sub_branches.misconception_alert: Misinterpreting half-symbols as representing 1 unit regardless of key value.
sub_branches.formula_or_rule: Partial Symbol Value = Fraction of Symbol x Key Value.
sub_branches.real_world_application: Public health awareness posters and population demographic charts.

key_nodes: Bar Graph Structure: Horizontal X-axis (Data Categories), Vertical Y-axis (Frequency Scale)
Proportional Bar Height: Height/length of each rectangular bar is directly proportional to category count
Consistent Axis Scale: Uniform grid step intervals along Y-axis (e.g., 0, 5, 10, 15, 20...)
sub_branches.misconception_alert: Using unequal bar widths or inconsistent spacing between bars on X-axis.
sub_branches.formula_or_rule: Bar Height Proportionality: Height = Category Frequency / Scale Unit Value.
sub_branches.real_world_application: Tracking canteen food wastage, monthly rainfall charts, and sales analytics.

key_nodes: Mode Identification: Tallest bar represents most frequent data category (highest mode)
Comparative Analytics: Finding differences between categories (Tallest Bar - Shortest Bar)
Trend Prediction: Drawing operational conclusions and action plans from visual graph profiles
sub_branches.misconception_alert: Misreading bar heights between scale grid lines on Y-axis.
sub_branches.real_world_application: Canteen food waste reduction campaigns, school attendance tracking, and sales reporting.
